crossRefs.note: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.

parallels.note: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.

translations.web: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
translations.bsb: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him, they placed him in custody.
translations.kjv: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done
translations.asv: And they put him in ward, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
